jobs.title: FLEX Manager, Product Owner
jobs.description:
This is a temporary position.

JOB SUMMARY

As a member of the Loyalty Financial Services Product team, the FLEX Manager, Product Owner (PO) is responsible for managing a portfolio of work to deliver Loyalty Financial related technical capabilities for Beacon driven by the Loyalty Finance and Operations organizations. This role will collaborate with business partners and technical teams to maintain a well-groomed and prioritized product backlog of features to include refined user stories with solid technical solutions that are ready for development. In addition, this role will support the Director in tracking and communicating the overall status of the backlog and reflect changes in business priorities.

The FLEX Manager, Product Owner (PO) will demonstrate management skills and leadership in a highly matrixed environment and must be comfortable working with multiple stakeholders on numerous competing priorities. This role requires moderate technical knowledge of software development processes and requires a proven record of creative solutioning and problem solving.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

Required

- Bachelor’s from an accredited university, preferably in a technology or business discipline or equivalent combination of education and experience.

- 5 years’ experience in the business, technology, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

- At least 4 years of experience with converting business needs into technology requirements.

Preferred

- Demonstrated ability to assess customer needs, creatively approach solutions, and decide and influence appropriate courses of action.

- Excellent communicator, both written and spoken. Must be able to explain product vision, business objective, technical feasibility, define requirements, and technical implementations.

- Demonstrated ability to deliver results under challenging conditions, particularly when faced with complexity, ambiguity, and aggressive timelines.

- Experience navigating a highly matrixed work environment where collaboration with multiple stakeholders is required to meet the needs of numerous competing priorities.

- Experience with or knowledge of Agile/Scrum software development practices

- Experience with Jira and Confluence

- Experience with Loyalty administration and/or financial administration

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Technical Product Owner

- Maintain a well-groomed product backlog of features to include refined user stories with solid technical solutions that are ready for development

- Help define new product features and optimizations of existing ones, and incorporate them into product roadmaps

- Support the definition of the Ambassador product requirements and development of the product roadmap

- Provide clear vision and scope documentation, use cases, workflows, and wire-frames to support development

- Coordinate with support teams for defect resolution

Demonstrating and Applying Discipline Knowledge

- Provides technical expertise and support to persons inside and outside of the department

- Demonstrates knowledge of job-relevant issues, products, systems, and processes

- Demonstrates knowledge of function-specific procedures

- Keeps up-to-date technically and applies new knowledge to job

Additional Responsibilities

- Proven ability to lead and work with cross-functional teams in support of specific business priorities

- Ability to solve problems quickly, think strategically, and drive data-driven decision making

- Ability to simultaneously manage multiple projects and aggressive timelines

- Strong interpersonal skills and success in cross-functional relationship-building at all levels, ability to drive

- consensus through influence and fact-based approach

- Effective written and oral communications skills with sensitivity to global communication needs

- Thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment

- Demonstrates self-confidence, energy and enthusiasm in leading and influencing teams

- Proficiency in Office software products and digital collaboration tools

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Hybrid) – Marriott Bonvoy Mobile App
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Marriott Mobile Product team leads the design, development, and innovation of the highly rated Marriott Bonvoy iOS and Android apps, used by millions of travelers to plan, book, and manage stays across 10,000+ hotels and 30+ brands worldwide.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead and mature key mobile commerce capabilities within the Bonvoy app. This role will play a critical part in advancing Marriott’s mobile growth strategy and supporting the company’s ambition to become the world’s favorite travel company.

This is a high-ownership role for a proactive product leader who thrives in complexity, is comfortable owning multiple product areas concurrently, and can context switch effectively while maintaining focus, quality, and momentum. The ideal candidate is eager to deeply understand the products they own—functionally, technically, analytically, and experientially—and grow into a recognized subject matter expert for their domain.

ON-SITE/HYBRID role in Bethesda, MD.

What You’ll Do

• Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for core aspects of the commerce funnel.

• Balance and deliver across multiple product workstreams, including strategic planning, delivery execution, experimentation, and stakeholder alignment.

• Develop and execute customer- and data-driven strategies.

• Lead experimentation and optimization efforts, including A/B testing.

• Become a deep subject matter expert across product functionality and UX.

• Lead cross-functional agile teams and drive delivery.

• Translate research, analytics, and experimentation results into action.

• Communicate status, plans and objectives clearly across teams and within the department.

• Navigate between strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

Required Qualifications

• 7+ years of product management experience with a focus on consumer-facing products.

• 5+ years leading cross-functional agile teams.

• Demonstrated experience delivering iOS and/or Android products.

• Proven ownership of A/B testing and experimentation.

• Ability to manage multiple initiatives and priorities.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Strong ability to lead, influence, and collaborate effectively with multiple stakeholders & across departments.

• Experience driving cross-functional initiatives within large, matrixed organizations.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

• Ability to engage in complex technical discussions regarding software development .

•Prior experience working in e-commerce.

• Experience with scaled agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe).

• Familiarity with analytics tools such as Adobe Analytics / Omniture.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.  We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Technology Product Management - Unified Experience Layer (UXL)
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Sr Manager, Product Management - Unified Experience Layer (UXL) is responsible for defining and executing the vision, strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for Marriott's Unified Experience Layer (UXL), a shared technology capability that powers customer, product, developer, consumer, and contributor experiences across Digital and Enterprise products. This role serves as the product leader for UXL and is accountable for driving platform adoption, product innovation, operational excellence, and value realization while ensuring alignment with enterprise business and technology objectives.

The Sr Manager partners closely with Digital, Enterprise, Engineering, Architecture, Experience Design, Operations, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, evaluate investments, and deliver scalable capabilities that improve customer experiences, accelerate development velocity, and enhance platform performance. This position owns the integrated multi-year UXL product roadmap and is responsible for balancing customer needs, business priorities, technical dependencies, platform modernization efforts, technical debt, and operational considerations.

As a strategic product leader, this role is accountable for the full product lifecycle, including product discovery, roadmap planning, business case development, prioritization, delivery oversight, adoption strategy, performance measurement, and continuous optimization. The Sr Manager leverages customer feedback, platform analytics, and stakeholder insights to make data-driven investment and prioritization decisions while ensuring successful delivery of measurable business outcomes.

The successful candidate brings a strong product mindset, platform-thinking approach, and experience leading API-based products and shared platform capabilities. This role requires exceptional stakeholder management skills, the ability to influence across a highly matrixed organization, and a proven track record of driving product adoption, alignment, and business value at scale. The candidate should also demonstrate exposure to or proficiency in Artificial Intelligence (AI), including the ability to leverage AI and automation to improve product management practices, introduce process efficiencies, accelerate decision-making, enhance product insights, and identify opportunities to create customer and business value through AI-enabled solutions.

This position serves as a product champion for UXL, promoting platform capabilities, responsible AI adoption, product best practices, and customer-centric thinking across Marriott's Digital and Enterprise ecosystem.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

Required:

-
8+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Digital Product Delivery, Technology Strategy, or related technology disciplines.

-
3+ years of experience leading cross-functional teams, initiatives, products, or product portfolios in a matrixed environment.

-
Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience/certification.

-
Experience leading digital products, API products, shared platforms, or enterprise technology capabilities.

-
Strong understanding of Agile product development methodologies and tools, including JIRA.

-
Demonstrated experience developing product vision, roadmaps, business cases, and investment recommendations.

-
Proven ability to translate business objectives and customer needs into scalable product capabilities.

-
Experience defining and measuring KPIs, product adoption metrics, platform performance metrics, and business outcomes.

-
Demonstrated ability to influence decisions and align stakeholders across business and technology organizations.

-
Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage technical teams, executives, and business stakeholders.

-
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and competing priorities.

-
Understanding of API technologies, service-based architectures, and platform products.

-
Experience leading shared products, enterprise platforms, or reusable technology capabilities.

-
Exposure to or proficiency in AI, Generative AI, and automation capabilities, with the ability to identify and apply AI-enabled solutions to improve product management practices, product operations, discovery, prioritization, analytics, stakeholder engagement, or process efficiencies.

-
Familiarity with responsible AI principles, governance considerations, and adoption practices for enterprise use of AI-enabled tools and solutions.

Preferred:

-
Experience with GraphQL technologies and API governance practices.

-
Experience managing platform adoption and consumer enablement programs.

-
Understanding of digital customer experience journeys and channel ecosystems.

-
Experience developing KPI frameworks, product reporting, and value realization dashboards.

-
Familiarity with product discovery techniques, customer research, and experimentation methodologies.

-
Experience partnering with Architecture, Engineering, Design, Operations, Security, and Enterprise teams.

-
Experience managing roadmap dependencies across multiple products and teams.

-
Knowledge of modern product management practices and Product Operating Models.

-
Experience supporting digital transformation, enterprise modernization, or platform transformation initiatives.

-
Experience using AI-powered productivity, analytics, collaboration, or product management tools to improve team effectiveness and decision quality.

-
Strong facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Product Strategy & Roadmap Leadership

-
Defines and executes the vision, strategy, goals, and roadmap for the Unified Experience Layer (UXL).

-
Establishes and maintains a multi-year roadmap aligned to Digital and Enterprise business objectives.

-
Identifies opportunities to improve platform capabilities, adoption, scalability, developer experience, and operational effectiveness.

-
Evaluates product opportunities and prioritizes investments based on customer value, business impact, risk, and technical feasibility.

-
Partners with leaders across Digital, Enterprise, and Technology organizations to align priorities and drive product direction.

-
Balances innovation, operational needs, platform modernization, and technical debt considerations within the roadmap.

-
Develops product business cases and supports investment recommendations and prioritization decisions.

-
Evaluates emerging AI capabilities, industry trends, and technology innovations to identify opportunities that accelerate product outcomes and create business value.

Product Lifecycle Management

-
Leads the end-to-end product lifecycle from discovery through delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

-
Drives product discovery efforts by gathering stakeholder feedback, customer needs, platform insights, analytics, and market trends.

-
Defines product requirements, epics, features, and acceptance criteria to support successful delivery.

-
Partners with Product Owners, Engineering, and Architecture teams to ensure roadmap execution aligns to strategic objectives.

-
Oversees backlog health, prioritization, and roadmap alignment across multiple initiatives and stakeholder groups.

-
Ensures delivered capabilities achieve intended business, customer, operational, and platform outcomes.

-
Uses AI-enabled tools and automation, where appropriate, to improve product discovery, documentation, insights generation, requirements refinement, prioritization, and product operations.

UXL Product Adoption & Consumer Enablement

-
Drives adoption of UXL products across Digital and Enterprise channels to expand usage and measurable value.

-
Improves onboarding, consumer readiness, contributor effectiveness, and engagement with UXL capabilities.

-
Partners with consumers and contributors to identify enhancements that improve usability, delivery efficiency, and product value.

-
Serves as a product advocate for UXL capabilities, GraphQL/API products, and reusable experience-layer offerings.

-
Streamlines enablement, intake, onboarding, reporting, and stakeholder communications through automation and AI-assisted workflows.

Stakeholder Leadership & Governance

-

-
Facilitates prioritization discussions and drives alignment across multiple business and technology organizations.

-

-

-

-

Product Performance & Analytics

-

-

Leadership & Product Excellence

-

-
Promotes product management best practices, customer-centric decision-making, data-driven prioritization, and responsible AI adoption.

-
Contributes to the evolution of Marriott's Product Operating Model and product management discipline.

-
Fosters collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, experimentation, and operational excellence across the product organization.

-
Champions the responsible adoption of AI across product management processes and encourages practical experimentation with AI-powered tools to improve team productivity, insights generation, documentation, and stakeholder engagement.

-
Maintains awareness of emerging industry trends, technologies, and practices relevant to AI, API products, platform products, and digital experiences.

Demonstrating and Applying Discipline Knowledge

-
Demonstrates expertise in Product Management, API platforms, shared capabilities, and digital product delivery.

-
Maintains knowledge of emerging technologies, industry trends, AI-enabled product practices, and modern product management methods.

-
Applies sound judgment and strategic thinking to complex business and technology decisions.

-
Acts as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders.

-
Leverages insights and best practices to continuously improve product performance, customer outcomes, and operational effectiveness.
